name: ZCA_FEED_FAILURE_RECORDS
description: This table stores the feed elements failure records while indexing to OSCS.

columns.name: FEED_FAILURE_ID
columns.description: Auto generated primary key of the table.

columns.name: FEED_ID
columns.description: Feed element id of the cloud event.

columns.name: FEED_FAILURE_STATUS
columns.description: Feed element failure status. Eg, STATUS_CLOUDEVENT_WRAPPER_VALIDATED

columns.name: SIGNAL_ID
columns.description: The id of signal generated for the cloud event.

columns.name: TOPIC_KEY
columns.description: The topic key of the feed element.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: Id of event object in feed element.

columns.name: RETRIABLE_FLAG
columns.description: To track if failure is retriable.

columns.name: FEED_FAILURE_SOURCE
columns.description:
To track if the failure record
was stamped by NRT or Indexing Job.

columns.name: FEED_FAILURE_EXCEPTION
columns.description: Failure exception of the feed element.

columns.name: FEED_FAILURE_SUMMARY
columns.description: Failure summary of the feed element.

columns.name: FEED_FAILURE_STACK_TRACE
columns.description: The failure stack trace of the feed element.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
